Scene 1: Intro
 <video> A video of a  colorful island with a treasure map, palm trees, and a glowing treasure chest in the distance.The treasure chest slowly opens and glows. </video>
The video starts playing. As the video ends, the activity will transition to the next scene

Scene 2: Getting Started
The narrator says <audio> We are going on a treasure hunt. </audio>.
A video of the treasure chest closing starts playing <video>The treasure chest gently closes.</video>

The narrator says <audio> Each treasure is a letter. Listen carefully and find the right ones. </audio>.

<video>A video showing chest opening and letter stones rising out and jumping in place is played </video>

The narrator says <audio> In each group of stones, press and hold the correct letter to collect the treasure. </audio>.

Scene 3: Letter d (lowercase)
The following letters are displayed on the stones : d, b, a, D, e
<audio>lowercase b !</audio>
<audio>lowercase a !</audio>
<audio>capital D!</audio>
<audio>lowercase e!</audio>
The narrator says <audio> Press and hold lowercase d. </audio>
If the correct letter is selected (letter d), the narrator says : <audio> Yes! That’s lowercase d! </audio>
if the incorrect letter is selected, the narrator says:
<audio> That’s </audio>Play the audio for the letter corresponding to the incorrect letter selected</audio>Find lowercase d ! </audio>

On the second incorrect attempt, the correct letter is highlighted with a scaling animation, all other letters get disabled and stay disabled. The audio for the corresponding incorrect letter plays. Then the narator says:  <audio> THIS is lowercase d. Press and hold lowercase d. </audio>
<video>Rock 1</video>
<video>Rock 2</video>
<video>Rock 3</video>
<video>Rock 4</video>
<video>Rock 5</video>
When the correct letter is selected, after the audio for the correct selection is played, one of the Rock 1, Rock 2, Rock 3,Rock 4 or Rock 5 videos is played, corresponding to te index of the correct rock.
